ed-stutter-tapestop.intent: A bar of 16th stutter on the bass, then a tape-stop fall on the last.
ed-stutter-tapestop.code:
setcpm(140/4)
// racks: pack:glyphcore/edm:racks-edm-depth

$: note("<~ [c3,eb3,g3]*16 ~>").hook("formantChop").vowel("a")
$: note("<~ [~ ~ ~ [c3,eb3,g3]] ~>").hook("tapeStop")
